Artwork from ''Super Mario Odyssey'' |species=Robot |first_appearance=''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]'' ([[2017]]) }} {{quote|If you ever want to use [[amiibo]], you just let me know, [[Mario|sport]].|Uncle amiibo|Super Mario Odyssey}} '''Uncle amiibo''' is a sapient robotic character who debuts in ''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]''. When the player talks to him, he allows them to scan an [[amiibo]] for one of two effects. Uncle amiibo can allow an amiibo to search for an unobtained [[Power Moon]]; the amiibo marks that Power Moon's location on the game's map. It takes five minutes for the amiibo to return with the hint. If certain amiibo are scanned, Uncle amiibo provides a matching [[Crazy Cap|costume]]. While these costumes can be obtained without amiibo, using Uncle amiibo makes them available earlier. Uncle amiibo always appears alongside Hint Toad, another character who helps Mario find Power Moons, and they are almost always found near where the [[Odyssey]] lands, the only exception being the [[Dark Side]]. Uncle amiibo only appears in a kingdom after all story missions within that kingdom have been completed. He appears in the [[Lost Kingdom]] after leaving once the [[Odyssey]] has been repaired and then returning. However, he does not appear in the [[Darker Side]] as it contains only one Power Moon. Uncle amiibo's dialogue has him refer to most scanned amiibo by the name of the character, even if they are not characters of the ''[[Super Mario (franchise)|Super Mario]]'' franchise and are used just as a generic amiibo. For example, if the player scans a [[Kirby]] amiibo, Uncle amiibo will say, ''"Let's see, that's... Why it's a good ol' Kirby amiibo!"'' If the player uses an amiibo that the game does not recognize, such as third-party characters or amiibo released after ''Super Mario Odyssey'', Uncle amiibo will simply refer to it as "a good ol' lovely amiibo." Many amiibo released before the game are labeled as "lovely" too, such as [[List of fighters debuting in Super Smash Bros. for Nintendo 3DS / Wii U#Duck Hunt|Duck Hunt]]. If multiple unknown amiibo are looking for hints at the same time, the subsequent ones will instead be labeled "cool" and "mysterious"; in a similar manner, the [[Super Mario Cereal|''Super Mario'' Cereal]] box will be referred to as a "delicious" amiibo. Scanning multiple variations of what is essentially the same character makes Uncle amiibo treat them as such and state that the amiibo is not done looking, despite many variations of the same character (such as the Yarn [[Yoshi]] colors and the Famicom and NES versions of [[R.O.B.]]) having different NFC chips. Uncle amiibo also suggests using the {{button|switch|right}} button to scan amiibo as [[Mario]] explores for other effects, as do several other characters in the game. Mario is able to stand on Uncle amiibo just as on a platform, instead of bouncing on him repeatedly as it happens when Mario [[jump]]s on any other character. ==Gallery== SMO Concept Art - Uncle amiibo.jpg|Concept art of Uncle amiibo Uncle Amiibo.JPG|In-game screenshot of Uncle amiibo SMOUncleAmiiboModel.png|3D model of Uncle amiibo ==Names in other languages== {{Foreign names |Jpn=amiiboおじさん |JpnR=Amiibo Ojisan |JpnM=Uncle amiibo |JpnC={{cite|quote=はじめまして！ ワタシは amiiboおじさん 突然ですが…|author=Uncle amiibo|date=27 Oct. 2017|title=''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]'' by [[Nintendo Entertainment Planning & Development|Nintendo EPD Tokyo]]|format=Ver. 1.3.0|publisher=Nintendo|language=ja}}{{cite|author=Sakai, Kazuya, and kikai, editors|date=2018|title=『[[The Art of Super Mario Odyssey|スーバーマリオ オデッセイ 公式設定資料集]]』|location=Tokyo|publisher=ambit|language=ja|isbn=978-4-19-864696-7|page=69}} |ChiS=amiibo大叔 |ChiSRM=Amiibo Dàshū |ChiSRC=Amiibo Daaisūk |ChiSM=Uncle amiibo |ChiSC={{cite|quote=初次见面！ 我是amiibo大叔。 冒昧打扰了……|author=Uncle amiibo|date=27 Oct. 2017|title=''Super Mario Odyssey'' by Nintendo EPD Tokyo|format=Ver. 1.3.0|publisher=Nintendo|language=zh-hans}} |ChiT=amiibo叔叔 |ChiTRM=Amiibo Shūshu |ChiTRC=Amiibo Sūksūk |ChiTM=Uncle amiibo |ChiTC={{cite|quote=初次見面！ 我是amiibo叔叔。 雖然有點突然……|author=Uncle amiibo|date=27 Oct. 2017|title=''Super Mario Odyssey'' by Nintendo EPD Tokyo|format=Ver. 1.3.0|publisher=Nintendo|language=zh-hant}} |Dut=Meneer amiibo |DutM=Sir amiibo |DutC={{cite|quote=Hallo, kleine!
